PROJECT.NAME: Izmjena MP cijena u cjeniku u %
PROJECT.CAPTION: Izmjena MP cijena u cjeniku u %

DODAJFORM.ONLOAD: select convert(datetime,convert(varchar(12),getdate()+1)), null as robaid, null as search, null as klasaid, null as podklase, 0 as postotak,7 as action
DODAJFORM.ONLOADED: select convert(varchar(10),@@datum2dok+1,104) as DatDo, 0 as akcija#select 'disable' as DatDo
DODAJFORM.CAPTION: Nova nivelacija

INPUT.NAME: postotak
INPUT.CAPTION: % promjene:*
INPUT.ONLOSTFOCUS: if coalesce(@@postotak,0)=0 begin exec spRaiserror 69001, 'Postotak promjene ne može biti 0 ! Potrebno je upisati postotak promjene !' end#if coalesce(@@postotak,0)=0 begin select 'postotak' as focus end

INPUT.NAME: akcija
INPUT.CAPTION: Akcija*
INPUT.ONCLICK: if @@akcija = 1 begin select 'enable' as DatDo end#if @@akcija = 0 begin select 'disable' as DatDo end#select convert(varchar(10),@@datum2dok+1,112) as DatDo#select @@DatDo as DatDo

INPUT.NAME: DatDo
INPUT.CAPTION: Datum do kada vrijedi promjena mp cijene:*
INPUT.ONLOSTFOCUS: if day(@@DatDo)=1 and month(@@DatDo)=1 begin exec spRaiserror 69001, 'Upozorenje: kao kraj akcije izabrali ste datum početka godine, što nije preporučljivo!' end #select 'refresh' as stavke

INPUT.CAPTION: Klasa:*
INPUT.NAME: klasaid
INPUT.SQL: select KlMasterRobaId, rtrim(sortkey)+' '+naziv as naziv from KlMasterRoba order by sortkey

INPUT.NAME: ok
INPUT.CAPTION: POKAŽI ROBU
INPUT.ONCLICK: select 7 as action#if (@@robaid is not null and '@@search' not like '') or (@@robaid is not null and @@klasaid is not null) or (@@robaid is not null and '@@search' not like '' and @@klasaid is not null) begin exec spRaiserror 69001, 'Ukoliko ste popunili polje Roba, ne možete pretraživati po ostala 2 kriterija (Traženje pojma i/ili Klasa robe) !' end else begin if coalesce(@@postotak,0)=0 begin exec spRaiserror 69001, 'Postotak mora biti različit od nule !' end else begin if @@datumdok < convert(datetime,convert(varchar(12),getdate())) begin exec spRaiserror 69001, 'Nije dozvoljeno unositi promjenu cijena na datum manji od današnjeg ! !' end else begin select 'refresh' as grid1 end end end#if coalesce(@@postotak,0)=0 begin select 'postotak' as focus end

UPDATEFORM.ONLOAD: if (select vezanicjenikid from TempPromMPC where TempPromMPCId=@@id) is not null begin exec spRaiserror 69001, 'Ne možete ispravljati cijenu na vezanom cjeniku !' end else begin if coalesce(@@id,0) = 0 begin exec spRaiserror 69001, 'Nema podataka za izmjenu cijena ! Kliknite na gumb Dodaj !' end else begin exec spMPNIvelacijaNG @action=12,@datumdok=@@datumdok,@robaid=@@robaid,@TempPromMPCid = @@ID end end
UPDATEFORM.CAPTION: Izmjena nivelacije artikla

INPUT.NAME: postotak
INPUT.CAPTION: % promjene:*
INPUT.ONLOSTFOCUS: select round(@@staracijena+(@@staracijena*(cast(@@postotak as money)/cast(100 as money))),2) as cijena

DELETEFORM.ONLOAD: if (select vezanicjenikid from TempPromMPC where TempPromMPCId=@@id) is not null begin exec spRaiserror 69001, 'Ne možete brisati cijenu na vezanom cjeniku !' end else begin if coalesce(@@id,0) = 0 begin exec spRaiserror 69001, 'Nema podataka za brisanje !' end else begin exec spMPNIvelacijaNG @action=12,@datumdok=@@datumdok,@robaid=@@robaid,@TempPromMPCid = @@ID end end
DELETEFORM.CAPTION: Brisanje nivelacije: @@opis
